probes.desc: each 510(k) risk axis is monotone: a worse value never yields a better verdict, from every base change type
probes.detail: monotone on 5 axes x 4 base types

probes.desc: a Class 1 recall stays reject across every combination of the other axes
unknown change_type is never a go (unknown is not a safe default)
missing change_type is never a go
blank evidence refs do not satisfy law 2 (no evidence = hold, not go)
unknown jurisdiction is never a go
a supplier substitution without equivalence evidence cannot soften a veto
postmarket Class 1 recall is reject
law 2 is reachable in the postmarket judge: zero evidence must produce verdict=hold AND an L2-EVIDENCED reason on record
postmarket judgement with an all-blank evidence package is never a go
unknown postmarket recall_class / cause type is never a go
a rule predicate that raises (unparseable event_report_count) is a hold signal, not a silently swallowed pass
an undeclared MCP role is denied (role is declared, not decorative)
the declared read-only role can still call a read-only tool
the documented {ctx: {...}} wrapper for judge_postmarket behaves the same as flat arguments
probes.detail: wrapped and flat arguments produce the same GateReport

probes.desc: non-object arguments are rejected with a JSON-RPC error, not a traceback
a judge that raises is reported in report.errors and fails safe to reject
CLI exit codes carry the verdict: 0=go 1=hold 2=reject 64=usage
the published change_type enum covers every change type the judge accepts
the published source_refs shape matches what the judges require (objects with a ref, not bare strings)
